parameters.query: with me as (select owner_id from app.listings where id = $1::uuid), k as (select trim($2::text) as c, right(regexp_replace($2::text, '\D', '', 'g'), 8) as d) select count(*)::int as other_listings, count(distinct l.owner_id)::int as other_owners from app.listings l, me, k where l.id <> $1::uuid and l.owner_id is distinct from me.owner_id and case when position('@' in k.c) > 0 then length(k.c) >= 6 and position(lower(k.c) in lower(coalesce(l.title, '') || ' ' || coalesce(l.description, ''))) > 0 else length(k.d) = 8 and position(k.d in regexp_replace(coalesce(l.title, '') || coalesce(l.description, ''), '\D', '', 'g')) > 0 end
